noteUpserted.title: Trail Warning
noteUpserted.text: Crude markings are scratched into the rock near the ravine's mouth — a jagged little glyph, repeated three times. A warning, or a boast.

narrationAdded.text: The trail narrows into a ravine, stone walls rising steep on either side. Loose scree litters the ground underfoot, and somewhere above, a pebble skitters loose — dislodged by wind, or by something watching from the rocks.
